properties.description: Generic parameterised BINARY dataset over any lake filesystem. Serves three jobs: the raw-ingest sink, Get Metadata existence checks, and the Delete activity that purges a curated partition before CETAS rewrites it. Parameterised down to the folder so a single dataset serves every source system: pass fileSystem='raw', folderPath='nyctlc/yellow/puYear=2024/puMonth=1'. Layout convention is <source>/<entity>/<partition-columns>/ - Hive-style key=value partitioning, because Synapse serverless can then prune on filepath() without reading the files.
